name: The Allen Law Firm
what_they_do: Small criminal defense and immigration practice serving New Jersey and New York, advertising availability 24 hours a day. Google reviews name Maribel Allen as the lead attorney, handling immigration matters such as adjustment of status alongside criminal defense.
customers: Immigrant individuals and families in NJ/NY facing removal, status and criminal-defense problems; Spanish-language service is offered via a site tab.

size_signals.signal: Single attorney practice with an 'Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week' promise
Google listing shows 48 reviews, several naming 'Mrs Maribel Allen' as the attorney
Service area stated as New Jersey and New York only

website_review.primary_cta: 'Contact Us' and 'Client Reviews' buttons in a rotating carousel
website_review.trust_signals: Client review carousel, no photos of the attorney or office, no credentials or years on the home page
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Home page body text totals roughly 2,000 characters with the same hero slide repeated; the mobile header renders as a blank white band, so no logo, name or phone is visible at the top of the page on a phone
website_review.search_basics: Title names criminal defense and immigration for New Jersey but not New Brunswick; meta description is generic boilerplate about being 'professional'; no JSON-LD
top_issues: Mobile header collapses to an empty white strip - business name and 24/7 phone promise vanish above the fold
Hero headline wraps mid-word and clips at 390px ('Representatio n')
Three different phone numbers circulate: site (732) 231-5500, a second on-site number (732) 828-9200, Google profile (732) 887-5739
No JSON-LD, no attorney bio or photo on the home page, and almost no written content for a crawler to quote

agent_readiness.notes: GBP is claimed with hours and 48 reviews, but the primary category is the vague 'Legal services' and the phone differs from the website. Content is genuinely thin: an agent asking 'do you handle immigration in New Brunswick?' finds little page text and no schema. Contact form exists but the mobile header is broken and there is no scheduling.

operations_signals.signal: 24/7 availability promise at a one-attorney office - after-hours calls are the obvious automation target
Google review topics include 'responsiveness' (2 mentions) and 'explaining details' (4), i.e. clients judge her on callbacks and clarity

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the mobile header and hero so the firm name, 24/7 phone and a tap-to-call button appear on a phone
top_opportunities.evidence: 390px screenshot shows a blank white header band and a headline that clips mid-word; the firm carries 48 local reviews on a phone-heavy audience

top_opportunities.opportunity: Consolidate to one phone number and one name across site and Google profile
top_opportunities.evidence: Three different numbers across site and listing (732-231-5500 / 732-828-9200 / 732-887-5739); GBP category is generic 'Legal services'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an AI-answered after-hours intake line that captures case type and language and books a callback, instead of relying on a one-lawyer 24/7 promise
top_opportunities.evidence: Site advertises 24-hour availability with a single named attorney; reviews praise responsiveness, so missed calls are the risk

scores.reasons: Gap is large: broken phone layout, near-empty content, no schema, inconsistent NAP. Ability to pay is limited - a solo immigration/criminal practice, though immigration cases carry meaningful fees. Ease is very high because the fixes are a small rebuild of one page. Evidence is medium: I inspected the live page and profile but could not get a review trend or traffic data.
